sources.title: Recursive Flint open-weight coding model (Oct 21)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Open-weight coding model Oct 21 (announce + HF weights created 14:20:58Z, 733 likes): 39.8B/2.5B MoE, 49 layers (2 dense + 47 MoE), 256 routed experts 6/token plus shared, SWA-513, 262144 ctx, 150144 vocab, cutoff June 2026; train from scratch (pretrain/mid/SFT/RL); Eureka Machine searched recipes and 4-bit lm_head quantization.
claims.context: HF model card + announcement page (both read; card LICENSE Apache 2.0)

claims.text: Terminal-Bench 2.1 54.9 / SWE-bench Pro v2 89.7 / SWE-bench Verified 74.2 (Terminus2/mini-swe-agent, temp 1.0/top-p 0.95/top-k 20, avg pass@1 5+ attempts, web-retrieval-as-failure); 125+ tok/s M4 Pro and 150+ 64GB RTX Spark publisher-claimed (short contexts, prefill excluded); 1xB200/H200 SGLang, 80GB, rec engine; Unsloth/LM Studio/vLLM/SGLang; 43 quants, 8 finetunes.

Apache 2.0 weights (card metadata); hosted API terms separate; WIRED Oct 21 hands-on corroborates same-day availability; Grok observed Flint plus M4 Pro chatter (no post IDs) as corroboration, not a second release.
claims.context: HF card license + WIRED hands-on + Grok raw topic mention

limitations.text: Publisher-claimed speed (M4 Pro/RTX Spark) unreproduced; full HF file hashes unvalidated; license file bytes unopened; one family with Grok corroboration (no double Selection)
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
